 CORAM : ARUN R. PEDNEKER, J.
 DATE : 03/11/2023

JUDGMENT :
1. Admit.
2. Heard the learned Advocate representing the respective parties.
The learned Advocate for the appellants has produced on record the order dated 14/07/2022 in First Appeal No.2939 of 2021, the parties are ad-item on the submission made.
The learned Advocate for the appellants also submitted chart on record.
The same is taken on record and marked 'X' for identification.

sentences.text: This Court while entertaining the appeals had recorded the submission of the appellants that they would not claim interest or 14 968 FA 4158-2023 statutory benefits for the delay period in filing the appeals and the delay was condoned on the submission of the appellants.
4. In view of the same, the appellants could not be entitled for interest or statutory benefit for the delay period in filing the appeal.

5. The learned Advocate for the appellant submits that only dry lands involved in the present appeals and the dry land compensation is enhanced to Rs.2250/- and is recorded by this Court in order dated 14/07/2022 in First Appeal No.2939 of 2021.
The same order would be applicable in the instance appeals.
Thus, I proceed to pass following order.

ORDER (i) All the appeals are partly allowed as under :-
(ii) Award passed in LA.R.No.184/1998, L.A.R.No.140/1998, L.A.R.No.144/1998,
L.A.R.No.142/1998, L.A.R.No.141/1998, L.A.R.No.145/1998, L.A.R.No.274/1998,
L.A.R.No.179/1998, L.A.R.No.11/2004, L.A.R.No.39/2004, L.A.R.No.160/1998,
L.A.R.No.187/1998, L.A.R.No.253/1998, L.A.R.No.275/1998, L.A.R.No.185/1998 and L.A.R.No.183/1998 be modified as per rate of compensation of Rs.2250/- per R. for the dry land.

(iii) The appellants are entitled to get interest under Section 28 and 34 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 from the date of 15 968 FA 4158-2023 award in the appeal where delay is not caused in filing the appeals.

The appellants would not claim interest or statutory benefits for the delay period in filing the appeals as delay was condoned on the submission of the appellants, that the appellants would not claim interest or statutory benefits for delayed period.

(iv) The appellants are entitled to get 12% per annum interest as special component from the date of notification under Section 4 (1) of the Act till the date of passing award 30/11/1997 under Section 23 (1) (a) of the Act.
(v) The appellants are entitled to get 30% solatium on the difference of market value under Section 23 (2) of the Act.
(vi) Liberty is granted to pay deficit Court fees, if any.
(vii) The award be modified accordingly.
No order as to costs.
Record and proceeding be sent back to the Lower Court.
All appeals are disposed of accordingly.
( ARUN R. PEDNEKER, J. ) vj gawade/-.

opennyai_summary.facts:
This Court while entertaining the appeals had recorded the submission of the appellants that they would not claim interest or 14 968 FA 4158-2023 statutory benefits for the delay period in filing the appeals and the delay was condoned on the submission of the appellants.
(iii) The appellants are entitled to get interest under Section 28 and 34 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 from the date of 15 968 FA 4158-2023 award in the appeal where delay is not caused in filing the appeals.
The appellants would not claim interest or statutory benefits for the delay period in filing the appeals as delay was condoned on the submission of the appellants, that the appellants would not claim interest or statutory benefits for delayed period.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: 4. In view of the same, the appellants could not be entitled for interest or statutory benefit for the delay period in filing the appeal.
opennyai_summary.decision:
5. The learned Advocate for the appellant submits that only dry lands involved in the present appeals and the dry land compensation is enhanced to Rs.2250/- and is recorded by this Court in order dated 14/07/2022 in First Appeal No.2939 of 2021.
The same order would be applicable in the instance appeals.
Thus, I proceed to pass following order.
(iv) The appellants are entitled to get 12% per annum interest as special component from the date of notification under Section 4 (1) of the Act till the date of passing award 30/11/1997 under Section 23 (1) (a) of the Act.
(v) The appellants are entitled to get 30% solatium on the difference of market value under Section 23 (2) of the Act.
(vi) Liberty is granted to pay deficit Court fees, if any.
(vii) The award be modified accordingly.
No order as to costs.
Record and proceeding be sent back to the Lower Court.
All appeals are disposed of accordingly.
